title: Unique Bouncy Dutch Banana Fritters
description: A nostalgic Dutch dish featuring bananas, deep-fried to a jammy and bouncy texture, perfect for a sweet snack or dessert.
instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl until they are well crushed.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and cinnamon.
Add the eggs and milk to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the mashed bananas to the batter and mix until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the banana batter into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm, sprinkled with powdered sugar if desired.
